The record shown in the bundle: summary "Travel Planning Schedule", data_owner "jordan.lee@northwind.example" (the actor), so owned. The list entry (not the full calendar record) has summaryOverride "Team Travel", hidden=true. So the failing condition is "shown in the calendar list" — it's actually hidden.

Step 3: The solver queries calendarList with minAccessRole=owner&showHidden=true. Response: exactly one entry: id c_4f89..., summary "Team Travel", accessRole owner, selected true, hidden true, summaryOverride "Team Travel".
